toolsPreview.name: check_payment_flow
toolsPreview.description: Verifies an agent's x402 payment flow against a free Base Sepolia testnet endpoint. Call with no arguments first to get back the payment-required challenge (price, network, payTo). Sign it with your x402 client, then call again passing paymentSignature as the encoded PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value to get back a verified/failed receipt.
